description:
Do QTL / GWAS loci for a trait sit in syntenic regions across pulse species? Takes the positioned
marker-trait associations for the trait (faba bean QTL compilation of 56 studies, lentil seed protein / amino acid
GWAS, soybean, common bean, cowpea and peanut GWAS / QTL markers from LIS), merges markers within window_kb into
loci, projects each locus onto the other genomes through collinear gene blocks, and lists the associations found
inside each projected region, flagging those for the same trait (all trait words present). Chickpea, pea, lupin and
Medicago are projection targets only (their QTL have genetic-map positions, not physical ones). trait: words, e.g.
'flowering', 'seed weight', 'protein', 'Ascochyta'; species: limit the source species; targets: limit targets.
name: qtl_colocation
